reviews.review_description: Great communication. They visited my home to discuss and finalise the quote. We had an old 1.5kw system that we wanted to upgrade entirely as part of our renovations. We explored various comparison/review sites looking for genuine reviews, and GoRun had some excellent scores and comments.We decided to get quotes from two other well reviewed installers who covered our area, as the industry, technology, and regulations are a constantly moving feat that we didn't feel we had a good grasp of.We knew exactly what we wanted to achieve before we talked to anyone. Jay from GoRun came out straight away, and sat with us fielding all our questions and concerns, as well as getting a good idea of what we were wanting. In a semi rural area reliant on power for our water pump and septic system, and having experienced significant power outages, we needed continuity of at least some power available if the grid was down. Our ultimate goal is to install batteries as well, so we needed an inverter that was already capable.Jay recommended a Fronius inverter that supports a PV outlet if the grid goes down, so we can keep essentials running as long as we have some sunshine. It is also ready to add in a battery array when we're able for even more independence. The Aiko ABC panels he suggested were also ideal as they perform well in cases of partial shading.Both the other companies we talked to suggested similar systems (the Fronius inverter was very popular), but neither one came to visit our site and understand our needs, so their proposed packages felt generic rather than specific to what we wanted to achieve. One was very close on pricing, the other wanted almost twice as much for a nearly exact system.We went back to GoRun with more questions to really dig into the nitty gritty of implications with our energy provider and Energex, and they always responded with relevant and accurate answers, without any pressure to proceed.In the end we felt as confident as possible with them as our supplier and placed our order. Their communication was spot on, and a week later we got a call to schedule our installation straight away.The team arrived yesterday morning, and every single member was friendly, respectful of our property, and professional going about their work. David from GoRun supervised the job, but they all knew their stuff, and Mark the electrician working on our board was splendid. Within a couple of hours all the panels were installed, and shortly after that the inverter came on line and we were tracking power on our mobile app. The site was left spotless.Of course, at that point the clouds had come over and it was raining, but to our surprise we were still generating power, supplying the house, and even sending some back to the grid.In no time at all we then received all the warranty and registration documents, they'd even done the admin for the extended warranty offer Fronius are currently providing.It's only day two, and it's still overcast and rainy, but we're generating, covering the household needs, and sending any extra to the grid.We went into this feeling we were treading through a minefield. We've come out this side feeling we've got a system that does the things we want, ready for our future plans, and with a supplier that did everything they promised as well as what we asked for, at a fair price for good quality technology, and as little hassle as possible.What more could you ask for?

I had a new 6.64KW solar system (415W Longi panels + Fronius Primo Gen24 inverter) installed a few weeks back by Go Run Solar. And I'm extremely happy with the services provided by Go Run Solar: from meeting the sales reps, to getting a quote, and getting the system up and running.Sales reps: David and Jay dropped by my place to explain the options available to me. They're both very friendly and knowledgeable about solar systems and the industry. They're honest and open with me, and provided good, solid advice on which system (panels + inverter) to choose from. They also spent a fair bit of time answering my questions, and also helped me with a couple of electrical related issues. I really appreciate both of them for their time and effort.Price: I've received several quotes before approaching Go Run Solar. After comparing the quotes, and also looking at the panels and inverter that they're offering, I believe what they offered was the among the best.Installation: I was able to get the system installed about a week after accepting the quote. Installation was done by the company's subcontractors, and they were friendly and professional. Everything was completed satisfactorily within a day. There were a few electrical issues encountered during installation which required some extra time to address. They stayed on and addressed the issues and made sure system was up and running before leaving.My system has been up and running for about 5 weeks now without any issues, and it was able to generate on average about 27-28kWh a day so far.Overall, the whole process was smooth and stress free. I'm very happy with the sales team, the price and also the installation. I would highly recommend Go Run Solar to anyone who's interested in getting a solar system.

We have long wanted to reduce our carbon emissions and embrace solar, but the industry just seemed so full of shonky companies and deals that sound too good to be true. I personally met with 3 companies who all had great reviews on Solar Quotes and came highly recommended by family and friends. The first company (a local electrician who does solar installs) came in at $6,333 for 6.6kW. The second company (a large energy retailer) came in at $5,220 for 6.6kW. Go Run Solar came in at $4,300 for 6.6kW including upgrade to black rails and clips. All companies quoted on Fronius Inverter and Jinko Panels (or equal).Go Run Solar impressed me with their depth of knowledge and their informed and balanced answers to my many questions. They offered real world advice that went beyond just the install and included great tips on how to get the best out of our system moving forward. The install had to be rescheduled due to a week of heavy rain and I was kept informed the entire time. The customer service from quote to completion has been first class. They even called me the day following install to check my house and yard was left clean and tidy and to see if I had any questions.
